summary: Read the entire 1,080-line markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A.1-A.6, and checked every estimate source against text extracted directly from the PDF. Rendered the numerical result passages and Figure 6 in memory to resolve corrupted text and confirm the distance measure. All recorded means, SDs, F statistics, degrees of freedom, and p values are correct and belong to the pooled Cue versus NoCue contrasts. All four automated quote alerts are false positives: the idea-topic result is on PDF p. 7 (printed p. 302), and the conversation-topic result is on PDF p. 9 (printed p. 304); their mathematical font encodings corrupt F, p, mu, and SD. The idea-count sentence is on PDF p. 9; its significant and difference ligatures are corrupted in extracted text. The Wilcoxon passage is on PDF p. 11 (printed p. 306), where conducted is split across lines as con- / ducted. The quotes match after these visually confirmed text-layer repairs and line-wrap normalization. The 172 people on PDF p. 5 are the randomized sample. Analysis-specific and arm-specific people counts and dyad counts are not printed; null analysis counts are appropriate. The first three outcomes concern dyad outputs: idea-topic variety is flexibility, conversation-topic breadth is other, and idea count is fluency. The two numerical REML analyses use dyad scores and support se_basis=cluster. The absence of a team option for sd_level is explicitly documented. Homogenization compares ideas across groups, and Figure 6 on PDF p. 17 explicitly shows cosine distance, supporting across_people, diversity, unit=output, and higher_is=more_diverse. Its centroid ambiguity is already disclosed. No numerical human-idea Wilcoxon result or arm summaries are printed; likewise, the idea-count contrast has no printed numerical result. Their null statistics and not_reported uncertainty are appropriate. All four estimates correctly record immediate outcomes with AI available, no within-person contrast, and ai_vs_bau. No additional eligible outcome or contrast was found. Pilot sessions, self-reports, attention measures, observational correlations, modality main effects, interactions, and the model-only revised-cue analysis are appropriately excluded.
